title: MoralityGym: A Benchmark for Evaluating Hierarchical Moral Alignment in Sequential Decision-Making Agents
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark, MoralityGym, is designed to evaluate the moral alignment of Reinforcement Learning agents in sequential decision-making tasks based on secular ethical dilemmas like the trolley problem.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this topic is outside the scope of its investigation into hierarchical moral alignment in AI agents.
